environment: This is Node.js ESM code with no external packages. Predict before running it; we can run it after your answer.

cases.surface: then callback that starts a save without returning it
cases.question: Predict the exact output order. What does the second then receive, and what decides when it runs?

criteria.description: Predicts next got undefined, then saved draft, in that order.
Explains that the first callback returns undefined, so the chained promise fulfills immediately with undefined and does not wait for the unreturned save.

wrongModels.claim: A then chain waits for any promise created inside the callback.
The chain waits for the save but passes nothing along because there is no return.

cases.surface: then callback that returns the next timed step
cases.question: Predict the exact output order. When does step b start, and what value reaches the last then? Give the reason.

criteria.description: Predicts sync end, done a, done b, chain got b in that order.
Explains that step b starts only when a's callback runs, and returning its promise makes the chain adopt b's settlement and value.

wrongModels.claim: Every step in a then chain starts at once when the chain is built.
Returning a promise from then passes the outer value through unchanged.

cases.surface: async forEach callbacks inside a save routine that shows a success banner
cases.question: A user saves two files. Predict the exact output order. Is the success banner safe to show at that moment? Explain what the awaits do and do not wait for.

criteria.description: Predicts all saved, show success banner, uploaded b, uploaded a in that order.
Explains that forEach ignores the promises its async callbacks return, so saveAll fulfills before either upload finishes and the banner is shown too early.

wrongModels.claim: forEach awaits each async callback in turn.
The uploads run in parallel and saveAll waits for all of them.
